ios.desc:
Make Your Chess Books Interactive and Elevate Your Study!

Transform your chess books into an interactive learning experience with our smart eBook reader. Simply double-tap on any chess diagram, and see real-time board setups appear instantly on your mobile device - no manual input required! Study your chess books effortlessly, and bring every diagram to life in seconds.

Key Features:

Instant Interaction with Diagrams
Double-tap on any diagram within your chess eBooks to view the exact board setup instantly. Make your study sessions more engaging and interactive without the hassle of manual entry.

All Your Books in One Place
Manage, organize, and sync your entire collection of chess books across all your devices - mobile and desktop. Always have your library ready, no matter where you are.

Analyze with Powerful Chess Engines
Evaluate positions using built-in chess engines. Analyze moves and strategies to deepen your understanding of every position and game you study.

Create Beautiful Studies
Select key positions from your books and easily create stunning PDF study sheets. Alternatively, export them to PGN for further analysis and sharing.

Search and Filter Diagrams
Looking for specific positions? Use advanced filters to search for diagrams across your books. Whether you're studying the French Defense or a specific endgame, you can find the exact positions you need.

Discover Related Resources
Automatically access related content, such as YouTube videos, Chessable courses, and Master’s games, directly from your books. Jump to the exact moment in a video where your position is explained, or explore games played by top players in similar situations.


Read the Terms of Use here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/


Reader Subscription available in the app:

$6.99/month ($49.99/year)
-Unlimited Diagram Interactions
-Unlimited Diagram Search Results


Prices may vary based on your location.

quotes.text:
Get for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.chessvision.reader

Get for iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chessvision-ai-ebook-reader/id6599857782

How does it work?

1. Open a chess PDF, DjVu, or ePub file

2. Wait for the processing to finish (only needed the first time)

3. Double-tap any chess diagram to interact and analyze

The app is a mobile version of https://ebook.chessvision.ai/ which I built some time ago. Over time I've received many requests to create a native mobile experience, so here it is.

To make it easy for everyone to try out the app, I’ve created a small PDF book with 18 mate in 2 puzzles from r/chess. You can claim the book directly within the app or download it from https://chessvision.ai/mates_in_2_from_rchess.pdf, then open it in the app. Have fun solving!
